def factor_price_volume_rolling_beta(df):
    """Rolling beta of returns on volume changes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    log_volume = np.log(df_copy['volume'].clip(lower=1e-12))
    dlog_volume = log_volume.diff()
    cov = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).cov(dlog_volume)
    var_vol = dlog_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).var(ddof=1)
    beta = cov / var_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    df_copy['factor_price_volume_rolling_beta'] = beta
    return df_copy['factor_price_volume_rolling_beta']
description: This factor measures the rolling sensitivity of daily returns to volume changes. A high positive beta means prices rise when volume expands, a hallmark of volume-confirmed accumulation or momentum. A negative beta indicates price declines on volume expansion, suggesting distribution. Unlike a simple correlation, beta is a structural elasticity that captures the coherence of price movement with volume behavior, providing a raw continuous signal likely to retain residual predictive power after neutralization.
